reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis aligns with known oxide passivation and thermal degradation phenomena in low-carbon steels, though there may be minor uncertainties regarding the stability and protective efficacy of the native oxide film.
reasons.testability: The proposed removal vs. retention of the native oxide under controlled exposure conditions, combined with standard corrosion measurements, provides a clear and decisive experimental path for falsification.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses the role of the native oxide in corrosion at different temperatures, offering a practical experimental design and meaningful baseline comparisons for researchers studying Q235 steel.
